items.headline: 9 touchdowns of at least 30 yards highlights FAU's 51-49 win over Rice
items.description: — Easton Messer piled up 262 all-purpose yards and scored five touchdowns and Florida Atlantic earned a 51-49 win over Rice, which had a four-TD day by quarterback Gael Ochoa in his first start on Saturday.

items.headline: Hellums runs for 5 touchdowns as Army rolls over FAU 56-24
items.description: — Quarterback Cale Hellums ran for 195 yards and five touchdowns and Army raced past Florida Atlantic 56-24 on Saturday.

items.description: Florida Atlantic (4-1) at Army (3-2), Oct. 17 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Leonard Farrow's 2 kickoff return TDs highlight Florida Atlantic's 66-10 rout of Texas Southern
items.description: — Leonard Farrow returned two kickoffs for touchdowns, Caden Veltkamp threw for four scores — three of them to Kelby Valsin — and Florida Atlantic routed Football Championship Subdivision-member Texas Southern 66-10 on Saturday night.
